key_requirements: GDPR applies: lawful basis, data subject rights, breach notification
enforcement_authority: National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP)
research_exemption: Derogations from GDPR rights (arts. 15, 16, 18, 21) for scientific/historical research and statistics with art. 89 safeguards (art. 8; statistics added by later amendment)
genetic_data: GDPR art. 9 special category; genetic data used for automated decisions/profiling need explicit consent or express legal basis with safeguards (art. 3(1))
